values.note: Every standard site has water and electric; the amperage is not published. No full-hookup sites are listed.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/table-rock/camping ('Each site has individual water and electrical hookups'; only 'Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 94 sites' listed), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 94 standard water/electric sites in two areas: 69 near the park entrance and 25 near the White Oaks picnic area; some take RVs up to 40 ft. Separate walk-in primitive tent area (Pine Point, 880-yard hike) and hike-in group sites.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/table-rock/camping ('The park provides a 69-site camping area, located near the park entrance, and a 25-site camping area, located near White Oaks picnic area'; 'Some sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet'; 'Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 94 sites'; Pine Point 'Hike to site is 880 yards'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park page says 'Wifi Available' without saying where.

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/table-rock/camping ('Both campgrounds are convenient to restrooms with hot showers'; Laundry Facilities: Yes; Dump Station: Yes; 'Wifi Available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the agency row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights. Same-day reservations go through the park. Check in at the Visitor Center on arrival; check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

note: Two camping areas, one near the park entrance and one near the White Oaks picnic area. Roads narrow/steep. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 94 W/E sites (69 + 25), RVs to 40 ft, water at site, showers, laundry, dump; added Wi-Fi (park-level 'Wifi Available'); booking confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window, 2-night minimum (AWH phone waiver) and 14-night max, now on the entry. Sewer false and camp store left as derived (no full-hookup row; store not on the camping page). Park advisory closes only the Nature Center and trailhead restrooms (deck/Carrick Creek project), not the campground. Fees left as read 2026-10-11. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: amperage, season, pull-throughs.
